intro: Christmas in July crafts are a delightful way to bring cozy cheer to your summer days, blending festive spirit with sunny vibes. Whether you're looking to brighten your home or create heartfelt gifts, these crafts offer a perfect summer twist on holiday traditions. From DIY decorations to charming ornaments, each project is designed to be fun, relaxing, and easy to shop for. Embrace the joy of crafting with materials that inspire warmth and creativity, helping you celebrate the season early in style.

picks.description: This Festive Mini Pine Garland Kit includes pre-cut faux pine branches, tiny red berries, and gold twine—everything you need to assemble a charming garland that brings a hint of Christmas greenery to your summer decor. Lightweight and versatile, it’s perfect for hanging on windows, shelves, or as a centerpiece accent. The materials are durable yet easy to work with, making it a relaxing summer craft for crafters of all skill levels. Include battery-operated micro LED lights for an extra cozy glow that lasts well into the evening.
picks.quirky_fact: Add a spritz of cinnamon essential oil to the garland for an authentic Christmas scent all summer long.
picks.shop_query: mini pine garland kit DIY Christmas in July

picks.breed: Red and White Felt Ornament Set
picks.description: This Red and White Felt Ornament Set features pre-cut felt shapes—stars, trees, and candy canes—with embroidery thread and needles included. Perfect for stitching simple patterns or adding personal touches like initials or dates. The soft texture adds cozy charm, and these ornaments double as sweet gift tags or summer tree decorations. The set is ideal for crafting with kids or friends, combining creativity with quality materials that won’t fray or fade in warmer weather.

picks.quirky_fact: Use metallic thread for a subtle sparkle that catches summer sunlight beautifully.
picks.shop_query: red white felt Christmas ornament DIY kit

picks.breed: DIY Snow Globe Mason Jar Set
picks.description: Capture the magic of Christmas in July with this DIY Snow Globe Mason Jar Set. It includes a mason jar, waterproof figurines, glitter flakes, and non-toxic glycerin to create a perfect soft snowfall effect. Customize with summer-themed holiday figurines or traditional Christmas icons to match your mood. These globes make lovely desk decorations or gifts that celebrate the season all year round. The step-by-step instructions simplify the assembly, making it an enjoyable project for cozy afternoons.
picks.best_for: crafters who love personalized, decorative keepsakes
picks.quirky_fact: Add a dab of waterproof glue around the lid rim to prevent leaks and keep your globe pristine.
picks.shop_query: DIY snow globe mason jar Christmas craft kit

picks.description: Bring greenery and festive cheer together with this Hand-Painted Christmas Cactus Planter kit. It comes with a ceramic planter, non-toxic acrylic paints in traditional holiday colors, and brushes. Paint your own holiday motifs like snowflakes, ornaments, or merry messages, then plant a real or faux Christmas cactus inside. This project adds a refreshing botanical touch to your summer space while nodding to Christmas charm. The planter doubles as a thoughtful gift or a seasonal home accent that stays cozy all year.
picks.best_for: plant lovers and DIY home decorators
picks.quirky_fact: Use painter’s tape to create crisp stripes or patterns before painting for a professional finish.
picks.shop_query: hand painted Christmas cactus planter kit

It includes soy wax flakes, festive fragrance oils like pine, cinnamon, and vanilla, cotton wicks, and reusable glass jars. The kit offers an easy, mess-free way to craft personalized candles perfect for summer evenings or Christmas in July celebrations. Soy wax burns cleanly and evenly, ensuring your handmade candles bring warmth and comfort. Gift them to friends or enjoy their calming glow yourself.

picks.quirky_fact: Add dried orange peel or cinnamon sticks inside the jar before pouring wax for rustic, layered fragrance.

picks.description: This Christmas in July Embroidery Hoop Art Set includes a wooden hoop, pre-printed cotton fabric with summer holiday designs, embroidery floss in bright reds and greens, and needles. Create charming wall art featuring festive motifs like Santa sunglasses or tropical wreaths. The manageable size and clear instructions make it an ideal project for relaxing, mindful crafting. Once complete, display your artwork alone or combine multiple hoops to create a cozy gallery wall that celebrates your unique summer holiday spirit.

It features pre-cut fleece squares in classic holiday plaids, fabric glue, and easy no-sew instructions. Assemble a soft, warm blanket perfect for outdoor movie nights or cozying up with a good book. The kit’s colors and textures evoke traditional Christmas comfort while being lightweight and breathable for summer use. This project is quick, mess-free, and results in a cuddly keepsake you’ll love year-round.

picks.quirky_fact: Add tassels or pom-poms to the edges for extra festive flair and texture.

faqs.question: What materials do I need for Christmas in July crafts?
faqs.answer: Most Christmas in July crafts use basic materials like felt, faux greenery, embroidery thread, mason jars, soy wax, and festive embellishments. Many craft kits include all essentials, making it easy to start without extra shopping.

faqs.question: Are Christmas in July crafts suitable for beginners?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Many Christmas in July craft projects are beginner-friendly with simple instructions, especially kits designed to be quick and mess-free. They’re great for families and those new to crafting.

faqs.question: Can I use these crafts as gifts?
faqs.answer: Yes, handmade Christmas in July crafts make thoughtful, personalized gifts. Items like candles, decorated planters, and ornaments show care and creativity, perfect for sharing cozy holiday spirit.

faqs.question: How do I store Christmas in July decorations after summer?
faqs.answer: Store decorations in labeled, airtight containers away from direct sunlight and moisture. Wrapping delicate items in tissue paper helps prevent damage so you can enjoy them again during the winter holiday season.
